correctness.rationale: For positive a,b,c every nonempty palindrome uses zero, one or two ones. The unique unary factor must be the unique longest run (its length-two trim is empty or repeats). At a marker the allowed radii are 0 through min(a,b) or min(b,c); the first radius absent at the other marker is the only minimal unique one. The two-marker palindrome is always unique, but positive padding leaves both markers in its trim; with zero padding the central zero run repeats iff an outer run is at least as long. These give the three indicators and the four cases b≤a, a<b<c, b=c, b>c for a<c (reversal handles a>c). Equality a=c yields one, and the minimum sum for a strict ordering is 1+2+3, giving length eight. Positive-composition summation gives all three series and the six strict order chambers have equal counts, with O(n) ties amongst Θ(n²) words. The condition on the central trim agrees with the standard MUPS definition, including overlapping occurrences and nonunique empty trim. The independent bounded literal replay matched every string/interval for 3,375 triples and every coefficient for 17,296 triples at lengths 5–50, including exactly the two claimed length-eight witnesses. At n=50 the counts were (23,720,338).
residual_risks: Finite replay does not establish the universal statement; that follows from the shape proof. No extension to zero gaps or more markers is assessed.

evidence: Watanabe et al. arXiv:1903.06290 Lemma 4 and Corollary 1 imply at most five MUPSs before a two-marker-specific comparison, and give a general per-word algorithm.
Mieno–Funakoshi Thm. 2 bounds aggregate lengths by O(n); Thm. 1 bounds interval-SUPS answer count by four. Mieno (CPM 2026) indexes maximal radii and internal longest-palindrome answers.
broader_coverage.reasoning: An algorithm evaluating each input can check any individual instance but has no result identifying the run-length order regions or summing over an unbounded set of compositions. The general bounds do not yield the sharp three, equality cases or rational counting series.

value.rationale: A canonical sparse test family for MUPS indexing now has exact positional witnesses and output counts at all lengths. The limit distribution distinguishes this palindrome-specific statistic from both ordinary uniqueness and a single query's SUPS multiplicity. The contribution is modest but reusable as a sharp exact benchmark, not a claimed speedup.
residual_risks: No algorithmic performance or empirical significance follows from this census alone.
